The '''millstone''' is used to recycle items in Masterwork. It is used to recycle various items not covered by the [[crematorium]], including [[cv:Remains|remains]], [[cv:Bone|bone]], [[stone]] as well as unneeded rock and bone items. Remains, bone and bone items are recycled to [[bonemeal]], which can be used as [[cv:Flux|flux]]. Rock items are destroyed entirely. Stone recycling has a small chance to produce copper, silver, gold or platinum ore with a slightly higher chance to produce coal, as well as a small chance to produce blocks.
